prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1455; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection with complaints of right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and difficulty with overhead activity. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior acromioclavicular region, reduced active abduction and forward flexion, and pain with resisted external rotation. Imaging was obtained and showed no acute fracture; findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury to the rotator cuff and periarticular structures.

Conservative management was selected and the patient attended 28 physical therapy and clinic visits over the course of care. Treatment included manual therapy, progressive range-of-motion exercises, graded strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers, cryotherapy, and a home exercise program. Anti-inflammatory medication was used for symptom control during the early phase.

Progress was steady but gradual. By the most recent visit, active range of motion had improved substantially, strength was near symmetric with the contralateral side, and pain with daily activities was markedly reduced. Residual mild discomfort with heavy overhead lifting persists. The patient is discharged to independent home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms worsen. Prognosis for full functional recovery is good.
